entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, [as if] it had issued out of the womb;

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made clouds the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddling-band for it,

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: And marked out for it my bound, And set bars and doors,

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days [began], [And] caused the dayspring to know its place;

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It is changed as clay under the seal; And [all things] stand forth as a garment:

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Hast thou comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest discern the paths to the house thereof?

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: [Doubtless], thou knowest, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or the way for the lightning of the thunder;

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: To satisfy the waste and desolate [ground], And to cause the tender grass to spring forth?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: The waters hide themselves [and become] like stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: Canst thou bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her train?

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: Canst thou hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: When they couch in their dens, [And] abide in the covert to lie in wait?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, [And] wander for lack of food?
